name: The Antichrist
overview: Scripture reveals the Antichrist as a deceitful and blasphemous figure who opposes God and persecutes His people. Described in Daniel as a ‘little horn’ speaking proud words and seeking to change times and laws, this person rises to power through cunning and flattery (Daniel 7:8, 7:25; 11:21). The New Testament warns of false Christs and prophets performing great signs to deceive even the elect (Matthew 24:24), while Revelation portrays the Antichrist as a beast with blasphemous names, ultimately defeated alongside the false prophet and judged eternally (Revelation 13:1; 19:20). This sober biblical portrait calls believers to remain vigilant and anchored in Christ’s truth.
